Product Features

  • Decorated with stylish faux leather design, there are beautiful LED lights around the bed, which are operated by a 24-key remote control, with 4 automatic switching modes and 16 light changing colors.
  • High load capacity metal slats plus 24 double-row slats, the load capacity is up to 350kg, so the mattress is not easy to sag, creating a comfortable sleeping environment for you.
  • Storage bed-With 35 cm of usable space under the slatted base, it is equivalent to storing a two-door wardrobe, ideal for small houses or apartments with limited space.
  • Durable-This storage bed features an easy-to-use hydraulic double-stroke mechanism and is made of good leather materials, including a sturdy center support beam and a padded frame.
  • Easy to assemble bed frame-The total size of the bed is 203 x 142 x 104 (114) cm, loadable up to 350 kg. This pad is shipped from Germany in a pack of 2. Descriptions

It's easy to make your home unique, this faux leather upholstered bed with LED light strip is worthy of your possession, the 140 x 200 cm double bed is a great choice whether it is used in the master bedroom or the guest room.
